description: Read-only shop directory by name. A listing proves no stock, price, delivery or checkout eligibility. Use search_catalog for product facts without store filters; it does not verify stock, price or delivery. Then call get_buying_options with the exact product_id, zip, quantity and fulfillment_mode. After the buyer chooses a returned offer with is_eligible_checkout true, use its store_id with start_checkout for direct checkout. An offer explicitly marked fulfillment concierge may also use start_checkout for a hosted request handoff even when that flag is false. Retain the exact buying context. A handoff does not reserve stock, create a durable quote or complete a purchase.

market.description: Market key, e.g. san-antonio-tx. Used when no zip is given.

name.description: Shop name or part of it, e.g. "Cheeky Monkey".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code: searches the shops within 15 miles of it first, then the national list. Pass it for any shop outside San Antonio.

name: find_stores

partial.description: True when not every listed shop could be compared.

alias_store_ids.description: Other store rows of this same physical shop, for display; search_catalog with the store_id covers them (PAS expands it).

url.description: The shop's page on the storefront.

title: Find a shop
